page.title: Calendar
page.description: Never miss a crucial lead. Discover how to streamline your appointments, deploy automated reminders, and maintain total admin oversight of your team’s schedule using our integrated Smart CRM calendar infrastructure.
page.body:
Calendar: Mastering Your Agency's Schedule


In a fast - paced real estate market, missing a meeting means missing a deal. The PropertyList infrastructure features a fully integrated Calendar built directly into your Smart CRM. This centralised scheduling tool is engineered to streamline your appointments, automate your reminders, and keep your entire agency flawlessly synced - all in one highly organised digital headquarters.

Key Strategic Features

Our integrated calendar provides a robust suite of tools designed to enhance productivity and eliminate double - booking:

✅ In - App Scheduling: Ditch the endless, confusing email chains! Schedule client meetings and property viewings directly within the platform. It is rapid, highly efficient, and keeps your entire deal flow strategically organised.

✅ Team Collaboration: Easily add team members to specific events to ensure everyone is informed, prepared, and operating with total clarity.

✅ Centralised Schedule: View all your critical events in one place - from client viewings and notary appointments to internal team catch - ups or personal commitments.

✅ Admin Oversight: Agency managers require complete transparency. Admins can seamlessly assign staff, oversee all calendar events across the agency, and ensure full visibility and better team coordination. Keep track of team schedules to ensure nothing slips through the cracks.

✅ Automated Reminders: Deploy optional automated reminders that will instantly notify you and your team via email and directly within the platform.

✅ Calendar Sync (Coming Soon!): We are currently developing seamless integrations that will allow you to sync your PropertyList schedule with most external calendar apps for a completely frictionless transition.

Pro Tip: Link Assets to Events

A true Smart CRM contextualises your data. When scheduling an event, you have the strategic advantage of attaching specific client details or property listings directly to the calendar entry. By linking a contact and a property, you instantly access all relevant information during the meeting - no more scrambling for details while the client is waiting!

Step-by-Step: How to Create an Event

To effortlessly secure a meeting within your infrastructure, follow this rapid workflow:
  1. Step 1: Access the Interface Navigate to the main Calendar tab on your dashboard. Click the “New Event” button, or simply click directly on your desired date and time within the calendar grid.
  2. Step 2: Input Core Details Add the essential event information, including comprehensive notes, the exact time, and the date.
  3. Step 3: Assign Accountability Assign a specific staff member to the event if needed. The infrastructure will immediately notify them within their platform dashboard and via email. Admins can easily sort and maintain an overview of all events by assigned user.
  4. Step 4: Link Your Assets Link the specific property to be viewed and attach the relevant client contact profile for easy, immediate reference.
  5. Step 5: Configure Notifications Set up your automated notifications to ensure the system reminds you prior to the event, preventing any missed opportunities.

Why Deploy the Smart Calendar?

  • Save Time: Spend significantly less time managing scattered schedules and more time closing high - value deals.
  • Stay Organised: Keep everything in one centralised, highly secure, and easy - to - access digital location.
  • Boost Communication: Share crystal - clear scheduling details with your team and your clients effortlessly.
  • Admin Control: Admins can effortlessly monitor all staff calendars for superior oversight and intelligent resource allocation.
  • Fewer Missed Meetings: Automated reminders ensure everyone stays on schedule and arrives fully prepared.
Take control of your time, enhance your agency's communication, and achieve real estate success with the scheduling power of the PropertyList ecosystem.
